input.question: Can Document QnA answer questions about an image (.png, .jpg), or does it only support PDFs?

content.content:
{"result":"Yes, Document QnA supports images in formats such as .png and .jpg, not just PDFs. The OCR processor can extract text, structure, and formatting from images, including PNG and JPEG, to create a machine-readable version of the document. This allows the language model to understand and answer questions based on the document content, whether it is an image or a PDF.

Here is the relevant code for processing an image with OCR:

```python
import os
from mistralai.client import Mistral

api_key = os.environ["MISTRAL_API_KEY"]
client = Mistral(api_key=api_key)

ocr_response = client.ocr.process(
    model="mistral-ocr-latest",
    document={
        "type": "image_url",
        "image_url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mistralai/cookbook/refs/heads/main/mistral/ocr/receipt.png"
    },
    include_image_base64=True
)
```

Alternatively, you can also pass a Base64-encoded image:

```python
import base64
import os
from mistralai.client import Mistral

def encode_image(image_path):
    with open(image_path, "rb") as image_file:
        return base64.b64encode(image_file.read()).decode('utf-8')

image_path = "path_to_your_image.jpg"
base64_image = encode_image(image_path)

ocr_response = client.ocr.process(
    model="mistral-ocr-latest",
    document={
        "type": "image_url",
        "image_url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{base64_image}"
    },
    include_image_base64=True
)
```

The Document QnA capability combines OCR with large language model capabilities to enable natural language interaction with document content, including images and PDFs.

content.text:
Yes — Document QnA is not limited to PDFs. It supports images (`.png`, `.jpg`, etc.) as well, since it runs OCR (via `mistral-ocr-latest`) on the input first to extract text/structure, and that pipeline accepts either an image URL or a Base64-encoded image, in addition to PDFs.

Example:
```python
ocr_response = client.ocr.process(
    model="mistral-ocr-latest",
    document={
        "type": "image_url",
        "image_url": "https://.../receipt.png"
    },
    include_image_base64=True
)
```

The extracted content then feeds into the LLM so you can ask natural-language questions about it, just as you would with a PDF.

**Source:** [OCR Processor — OCR with images and PDFs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/basic_ocr#ocr-images)
